hooks.text: NASA electroplated radioactive uranium onto a golden record heading into deep space.
Why did NASA put radioactive uranium-238 on a golden record for aliens?
NASA bolted a radioactive clock to a probe sent to aliens.

title: The Atomic Clock Bolted to Voyager's Golden Record
description: Discover how NASA used a tiny, ultra-pure sample of radioactive uranium-238 to build a silent atomic clock on the Voyager Golden Record.

beats.text: NASA electroplated radioactive uranium onto a golden record heading into deep space.
beats.visual: The Voyager Golden Record cover diagram showing the symbols, 1977

beats.text: In 1977, the twin Voyager probes launched toward interstellar space carrying human messages.
beats.visual: Illustration of the Voyager 1 spacecraft cruising in deep space, 1977

beats.text: Led by astronomer Carl Sagan, the team packed 55 languages and whale songs onto disks.
beats.visual: Portrait of astronomer Carl Sagan at Cornell University, 1970s

beats.text: Each record was sealed inside an aluminum cover featuring a map of 14 pulsars.
beats.visual: Detail of the pulsar map etched on the Pioneer and Voyager spacecraft plaques, 1977

beats.text: If an alien civilization intercepts a probe, how will they calculate its age?
beats.visual: Artist concept of an interstellar probe drifting through a distant star system

beats.text: This is why scientists placed a tiny, ultra-pure sample of uranium-238 on the cover.
beats.visual: Photograph of the gold-plated Voyager Golden Record next to its aluminum cover, 1977

beats.text: Because this isotope decays with a half-life of about 4.5 billion years, it acts as a clock.
beats.visual: Diagram of radioactive decay cycles of heavy elements

beats.text: Measuring remaining uranium and decay products reveals exactly when the spacecraft left Earth.
beats.visual: Photograph of planet Earth from interstellar space taken by Voyager 1, 1990

beats.text: No matter how long it drifts, this silent atomic clock tells the exact age of the mission.
beats.visual: The Voyager Golden Record cover diagram showing the symbols, 1977
